title: Cycle Break
statement: Implement `solve(kind)`. `kind` is `delay` or `third`. `delay` means break the cycle by importing inside the function that needs it. `third` means move the shared object into a third module both sides import. Return `move-import` for delay and `new-module` for third. Any other kind returns `error`.
hints: Do not return the input unchanged.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A cycle between two modules often means each wants a name from the other at import time.

editorial: A cycle between two modules often means each wants a name from the other at import time. Moving one import into the function delays it until both modules have finished loading. Moving the shared type into a third module removes the edge. Those are the two structural fixes.
